rules.title: Ban on sale or use of coordinated pricing algorithms to set rents or occupancy
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use a coordinated pricing algorithm (software that uses nonpublic competitor data less than 90 days old to recommend rents, fees or occupancy) to set rents or occupancy levels for Berkeley rental units, and vendors may not sell or license such algorithms to Berkeley landlords. A tenant harmed by a landlord's use can sue for an injunction, damages, civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, and attorney's fees.
rules.key_value: Prohibited; civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation (each month and each unit is a separate violation)
rules.coverage_conditions: All residential dwelling units in the City of Berkeley; applies to landlords and to anyone selling, licensing or providing coordinated pricing algorithms to Berkeley landlords.
rules.exemptions: Does not cover products that publish aggregated, anonymous rental data without recommending rents; products for setting affordable-housing rent or income limits; and information used for project-financing market research, appraisals, or software research, testing or training (as long as competitor data is not an input when a recommendation is produced).
rules.quoted_span: It shall be unlawful for a landlord to use a coordinated pricing algorithm described
rules.penalty: City Attorney civil action for damages, injunctive relief, restitution and civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation; tenant civil action for injunctive relief, damages and civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation; prevailing party (City Attorney or tenant) gets attorney's fees. Each month and each unit counts as a separate violation.
rules.conflict_note: The document does not state an effective date. It records passage to print on 2025-11-18, and the URL points to a 2025-12-02 adoption agenda item. The ordinance amends an existing BMC Chapter 13.63, so an earlier version of the ban may already have been in effect. This document does not mention California state law on common pricing algorithms; reviewers should check whether it overlaps with this ordinance or preempts it.

notes: The document is Berkeley Ordinance 7,992-N.S., which amends BMC Chapter 13.63. I extracted it as one rule; the bans on selling (13.63.030(A)) and using (13.63.030(B)) these algorithms are combined into one record. No effective date is stated. The document shows passage to print on 2025-11-18 and suggests final adoption on 2025-12-02, so I treated the rule as in force by 2026-10-01. Under 13.63.010(F), the chapter does not limit rent amounts, so I did not extract a rent_increase_limits rule. No other categories appear in the document.
